ok.description: False when the command itself could not run.

diff_patch.description: Green and wave gates: path of the patch the gate wrote for the commit it measured. Given to the next reviewer.

flaky.description: Identities of inherited tests that failed and then passed when the gate ran the suite once more (the flaky rule of record:baseline). Copied into the unit's closure record.

unit.description: Only from vsdd gate plan --story, and always when it passes: the admitted story unit (section 2.10.8).

test_output.description: Green gate: path of the log holding every configured command's output (green.<sha12>.log). Empty when the gate wrote none.

changed_files.description: Green gate with --since: the files the range changed (vsdd.state.verdicts.changed_files, --no-renames); [] without --since.
